paragraphs.body: The Charlotte Hornets suffered a 128-81 defeat to the Atlanta Hawks in their first home game without LaMelo Ball, resulting in a blowout that left the team looking lost despite a sellout crowd booing the performance. While the team celebrated a 40-point victory in another recent game with new faces turning heads, the collapse in the loss against Atlanta was highlighted by Coby White sending a blunt message regarding the team's 27 turnovers. Fans remain optimistic for the new season and playoff contention, though questions persist after Naz Reid was shockingly benched and the team desperately needs Kon Knueppel and Coby White back from injury.

headline: Charlotte Hornets face a tough season without LaMelo Ball, dealing with blowouts, injuries, and fan questions.
